name: Energy Aspects
description:
Energy Aspects gives AI agents direct access to expert energy market intelligence — research reports, real-time analyst commentary, and timeseries data across oil, gas, power, and related markets.

Energy Aspects is an independent research firm trusted by traders, investors, and energy professionals worldwide. The connector draws on three content types: in-depth research publications with analysis and forecasts; EA Live posts with intraday market commentary from analysts; and a library of quantitative timeseries covering supply, demand, inventories, flows, and prices — including point-in-time queries against historical releases.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Energy Aspects to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Energy Aspects to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.energyaspects.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Energy Aspects MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Energy Aspects provides these MCP tools: get_ea_live_posts, get_insight_and_data, get_publications, and get_timeseries_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Energy Aspects?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Energy Aspects in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Energy Aspects MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Energy Aspects requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Energy Aspects is developed by Energy Aspects. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
